messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: RESERVED_CAPACITY_LOW for tenant 'BlueSky'. Metric: reserved_pool_latency_p95 > 1200ms and 5xx_rate > 4%. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/1745543210. Pager: alex.

PagerDuty: Paging alex (primary oncall) — acknowledge to stop escalation.

alex: acked. I'm the oncall. grabbing context. Can someone paste quick customer impact?

priya: I've got a rough read — cluster blue-sky-reserved-3 showing node OOMs and kernal-side evictions on tp-gpu-4. Looks like recent quant-kernel rollout increased memory pressure. Non-user facing infra routes look fine.

marta: seeing drop in serving replicas for the tenant's reserved pool; autoscaler didn't kick (disabled for this pool). 5xx are mostly 503/504 timeouts from proxy when backend pods disappear.

alex: ok. follow runbook 3-b: temporary burst capacity + fallback model. Steps I plan: 1) enable burst x2 2) route non-critical routes to fallback model 3) notify CS.

alex: running tenant-status to get counts:
```
$ ./bin/tenantctl status --tenant BlueSky --format=json
{
  "active_replicas": 3,
  "pending_replicas": 0,
  "queue_depth": 120,
  "p95_latency_ms": 1420,
  "5xx_rate_percent": 4.8
}
```

priya: run this to add burst capacity (will pull from shared reserved pool):
```
$ rctl capacity adjust --tenant BlueSky --burst-multiplier 2 --reason "auto-pager emergency"
Applying burst multiplier 2... OK (new burst capacity assigned)
```

alex: applied. rctl returned success. queue depth dropping from 120 -> 60 in last 30s.

marta: suggestion: pin BlueSky to fallback model `redwood/gpt-small-quant` for now to reduce memory. Quality drop expected ~3-5% but avoids OOMs. Command to update route: 
```
$ deployctl update-route --tenant BlueSky --route default --model redwood/gpt-small-quant --weight 100
```

alex: deploying fallback route now.
```
> deployctl update-route --tenant BlueSky --route default --model redwood/gpt-small-quant --weight 100
Updating route... done.
```

cs-team: BlueSky CS ping: can we get estimated % of requests impacted and ETA for full recovery? Customer-facing message to hold until we have numbers.

alex: current snapshot: ~4.8% 5xx, p95 1420ms. After burst + fallback, p95 trending down to ~700ms, 5xx at ~1.2% stabilized. ETA for stable: 10-15m.

priya: autoscaler disabled intentionally due to manual tuning; scaling up now manually. Running kubectl scale to 6 replicas for the reserved pool.
```
$ kubectl -n reserved-blue-sky scale deploy/blue-sky-serving --replicas=6
deployment.apps/blue-sky-serving scaled
```

marta: metrics look better — cpu/memory pressure dropping. No new evictions in last 2m. Good signal.

incident-bot: PagerDuty notice: alex acknowledged at 1745543225. Escalation suppressed.

alex: handing off active mitigation/monitoring to priya for next 2 hours. Priya — can you own postmortem + follow-up with infra team and revert fallback once we confirm stable? I'll update the incident ticket and draft customer note.

priya: taking it. I'll keep this bridge open and work with infra to rollback quant-kernel on the affected pool if needed. Opening an infra ticket: https://tickets.redwood.internal/ISSUE-11234

cs-team: noted. We'll prepare a holding statement for BlueSky: short note saying we experienced elevated latency and 5xx for ~20m starting at ~1745543210, mitigated by scaling and failover to fallback model. We'll wait for final numbers before sending.

alex: adding followups: 1) postmortem (owner: priya) due in 72h 2) add automated safety to prevent autoscaler-disabled pools from being single-point-of-failure 3) telemetry alert tuning — reduce sensitivity to quant-kernel rollouts.

marta: creating a short runbook patch to call out this kernel + reserved-pool interaction.

incident-bot: Incident state: Mitigated. Willauto-close page if no regressions in 30m.

alex: closing my oncall loop; priya you have the handoff. tagging :white_check_mark:.

priya: thanks. I'll monitor and ping here if anything regresses.

cs-team: thanks all — keeping customer waiting note queued until final metrics. :thumbsup:

marta: quick note — postmortem checklist entry: capture model version, kernel version, deploy window, and exact memory footprints for BlueSky pods.

alex: logged incident ticket and linked dashboards in ISSUE-11234. Reactions: :rotating_light: :white_check_mark: :coffee:
